cards.name: Basketmaker's Workshop
cards.text: In each harvest, you can use the Basketmaker's Workshop to convert exactly 1 reed to 3 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1/2/3 bonus points for 2/4/5 reed.

cards.name: Clay Oven
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can turn exactly 1 grain into 5 food. When you take this card, you can also bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Cooking Hearth
cards.text: At any time, you may convert goods to food as follows: vegetable → 3 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 3 food; cattle → 4 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 3 food.

cards.name: Fireplace
cards.text: At any time, you may convert goods to food as follows: vegetable → 2 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 2 food; cattle → 3 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 2 food.

cards.name: Joinery
cards.text: In each harvest, you can use the Joinery to convert exactly 1 wood to 2 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1/2/3 bonus points for 3/5/7 wood.

cards.name: Pottery
cards.text: In each harvest, you can use the Pottery to convert exactly 1 clay to 2 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1/2/3 bonus points for 3/5/7 clay.

cards.name: Stone Oven
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can turn up to 2 grain into 4 food each. When you take this card, you can bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Well
cards.text: Place 1 food from the general supply on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Beer Festival
cards.text: You can bake bread immediately when you play this card. At the end of the game, you get 1 bonus point for every 3 food you have left, with a maximum of 3 points.

cards.name: Bible
cards.text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each family member that has used one of the following action spaces in the preceding round consumes 1 fewer food: "Plough 1 Field", "Plough Field and Sow", "Take 1 Grain", "Take 1 Vegetable", and "Day Labourer",

cards.name: Chapel
cards.text: The Chapel is an additional action space. Whenever a player uses it, they can discard up to 2 begging cards. Every begging card is paid with 1 stone, which is placed on the Chapel. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each stone on this card.

cards.name: Five-year Plan
cards.text: Place a claim marker on an empty field. You cannot sow again on this field. It no longer counts as a field, but only as a used farmyard space. You may immediately sow on all of your other empty fields. Put 2 extra grain or vegetables on each stack that you plant.

cards.name: Golden Hands
cards.text: Whenever you play a minor or major improvement, you can replace exactly 1 building resource with another.

cards.name: Golem
cards.cost: 1VP. Cost 2C. Req oven or cooking hearth.
cards.text: Place the 2 clay that you paid on this card. At the start of each of the next 2 rounds, return 1 of the clay to the general supply. In these 2 rounds, you use the action space where you place your first person, twice in succession. For accumulating action spaces, this means that for the second action you receive the number of resources or food that is added at the start of each round.

cards.name: Hop Field
cards.text: You can immediately pay 1 to 4 wood to place that many fences on one of your empty fields. This field is no longer suitable for sowing, but will be scored as a field at the end of the game. For each fence on the field you receive 1 food immediately and 1 bonus point at the end of the game.

cards.name: Hunger Wall
cards.text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each player can pay 1 clay instead of 2 food to feed exactly 1 family member. Each paid clay is placed on this card. You receive 1 bonus point for every 2 clay on this card at the end of the game.

cards.name: School
cards.text: Whenever you can play 1 minor or major improvement, you can play 1 occupation instead. The price of the occupation is 1 food.

cards.name: Venus Figure
cards.text: Whenever you use the action space "Family Growth and Minor Improvement", you may carry out the family growth action twice in the same turn, using only 1 person.

cards.name: Wagenburg
cards.text: You may place 1 fence on each of any number of your unused farmyard spaces. This costs 1 wood per fence. You may at any time return a fence from a farmyard space to your personal supply. Spaces with fences count as used at the end of the game.

cards.name: Wine Cellar
cards.text: Immediately convert one of your unfenced stables to a wine cellar by turning it on its side. You can no longer keep animals in it. You receive 2 food from the general supply in the field phase of each harvest. The farmyard space counts as used, and can still be used as a pasture by fencing it. The wine cellar does not count as a stable.

cards.name: Animal Pen
cards.text: Place 2 food on each remaining round space. At the start of each round, you receive the food.

cards.name: Axe
cards.text: Whenever you add a room to your wooden hut, you only pay 2 wood and 2 reed.

cards.name: Baker's Oven
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can use the Baker's Oven to convert up to 2 grain into 5 food each. When you play this card, you can also bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Baking Tray
cards.text: The Clay Oven and Stone Oven are minor improvements for you. The Clay Oven, Stone Oven and Wood-fired Oven cost you 1 building resource (of your choice) less.

cards.name: Basket
cards.text: Whenever you use a person's action to take wood that is on an action space, you can leave 2 of that wood on the action space and receive 3 food in exchange.

cards.name: Bean Field
cards.text: When you sow, you can plant vegetables on this card as though it were a field.

cards.name: Builder's Trowel
cards.text: You can renovate your wooden hut to a clay hut at any time without using a “Renovate” action.

cards.name: Building Material
cards.text: You receive either 1 wood or 1 clay when you play this card. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Butter Churn
cards.text: Whenever you have sheep during the field phase of a harvest, you receive 1 food for each third sheep. Whenever you have cattle during the field phase, you receive 1 food for each second cattle.

cards.name: Canoe
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you receive an additional 1 food and 1 reed.

cards.name: Carp Pond
cards.text: Place 1 food on each remaining odd-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Cattle Market
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 cattle. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Ceramics
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 2 food. From now, the Pottery is a minor improvement for you and costs you nothing.

cards.name: Clay Roof
cards.text: You can replace 1 or 2 reed with the same amount of clay whenever you extend or renovate your home.

cards.name: Clay Supports
cards.text: Whenever you add a room to your clay hut, you can pay 2 clay, 1 wood and 1 reed instead of 5 clay and 2 reed.

cards.name: Clogs
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for a clay hut, or 2 bonus points for a stone house.

cards.name: Corn Scoop
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Take 1 Grain" action space, you receive 1 additional grain.

cards.name: Dovecote
cards.text: Place 1 food on each remaining space for rounds 10 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Drinking Trough
cards.text: Each pasture (with or without a stable) can hold up to 2 more animals.

cards.name: Feed Pellets
cards.text: During the feeding phase of each harvest, you may trade 1 vegetable for 1 of any type of animal that you already have in your farmyard.

cards.name: Field
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately plough 1 field. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Fishing Rod
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you receive 1 additional food. From round 8 onwards, you receive 2 additional food.

cards.name: Fruit Tree
cards.text: Place 1 food on each remaining round space for rounds 8 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you receive food.

cards.name: Gypsy's Crock
cards.text: Whenever you convert any 2 goods to food at one time using a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth or Cooking Corner, you receive 1 additional food.

cards.name: Half-timbered House
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each room in your stone house.

cards.name: Helpful Neighbours
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive either 1 stone or 1 reeds. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Lettuce Patch
cards.text: On this card, you can plant vegetables as you would on a field. Vegetables on this field can be converted to 4 food when harvested.

cards.name: Madonna Statue
cards.text: The Madonna Statue has no effect.

cards.name: Manger
cards.text: At the end of the game, if your pastures occupy 6/7/8/9+ farmyard spaces, you receive 1/2/3/4 bonus points.

cards.name: Market Stall
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 vegetable. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Millstone
cards.text: Whenever you bake 1 or more grain into bread, you receive 2 additional food.

cards.name: Mini Pasture
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately fence one space in your farmyard. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Outhouse
cards.text: The Outhouse has no effect. You can only build it if at least one other player has fewer than 2 occupations.

cards.name: Plane
cards.text: Whenever you turn 1 wood into food using the Joinery, Sawmill or Cabinetmaker, you receive 1 additional food. You can choose instead to turn a second wood into exactly 2 food.

cards.name: Potato Dibber
cards.text: Whenever you sow fields with vegetables, place 1 additional vegetable from the general supply on each newly sown stack of vegetables.

cards.name: Private Forest
cards.text: Place 1 wood on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you receive the wood.

cards.name: Quarry
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action space, you receive an additional 3 stone.

cards.name: Raft
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you receive an additional 1 food or 1 reed.

cards.name: Reed Pond
cards.text: Place 1 reed each on the next 3 remaining round spaces. At the start of each round, you receive the reed.

cards.name: Riding Plough
cards.text: Twice during the game, when you use either the "Plough 1 Field" or "Plough Field and Sow" action space, you can plough 3 fields instead of 1.

cards.name: Sack Cart
cards.text: Place 1 grain on each remaining space for rounds 5, 8, 11 and 14. At the start of these rounds, you receive the grain.

cards.name: Shepherd's Pipe
cards.text: You can hold up to 2 additional sheep in each of the pastures where you keep sheep. You can keep up to 2 sheep in each unfenced stable.

cards.name: Simple Fireplace
cards.text: At any time, you may convert goods to food as follows: vegetable → 2 food; sheep → 1 food; wild boar → 2 food; cattle → 3 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 2 food.

cards.name: Spices
cards.text: Whenever you convert vegetables to food using a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth or Cooking Corner, you receive 1 additional food.

cards.name: Stable
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately build 1 stable. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Stone House Extension
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately extend your stone house by 1 room. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Stone Tongs
cards.text: Whenever you use one of the "1 Stone" action spaces that become available in rounds 5--7 and 10--11, you receive 1 additional stone.

cards.name: Turnwrest Plough
cards.text: Once during the game, when you use either the "Plough 1 Field" or "Plough Field and Sow" action space, you can plough 3 fields instead of 1.

cards.name: Windmill
cards.text: At any time, you can convert grain to 2 food (without having to bake bread).

cards.name: Wood-fired Oven
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can use the Wood-fired Oven to turn any number of grain into 3 food each. When you play this card, you can also bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Writing Desk
cards.text: Whenever you take an “occupation” action on an action space, you may play 2 occupations one after another. The second occupation costs you 2 food.

cards.name: Almanac
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately take the field and breeding phases of a harvest on your farmyard. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Animal Farm
cards.text: Once per round, you may return 1 of your animals to the supply for a guest token, which you place this round as you would a family member. (The guest represents the animal.)

cards.name: Baking Field
cards.text: When you sow, you can plant grain on this card as you would on a field. When harvesting, you must immediately bake this field's harvested grain.

cards.name: Bartering Hut
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately buy up to 2 animals from the general supply. Pay any 2 building resources for each sheep, any 3 for each wild boar, and any 4 for each cattle. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Beehive Oven
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can use the Beehive Oven to convert up to 1 grain into 4 food. Whenever you bake 1 or more grain into bread without using the Beehive Oven, you receive 1 additional food. When you play this card, you can also bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Birthstone
cards.text: Whenever you grow your family, you may pay 1 stone for 1 bonus point. When you play Birthstone, you may immediately do this for any new family member that you already received this round.

cards.name: Bountiful Harvest
cards.text: If you harvest at least 2 resources and breed at least 1 animal during a harvest, place 1 food from the general supply on this card. You may use this food at any time. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each food on this card.

cards.name: Chronicle
cards.text: Place 1 food on each remaining major improvement on the major improvements board. When these improvements are acquired, you receive the food.

cards.name: Clear Cutting
cards.text: Whenever you plough 1 or more fields, you receive 1 wood from the general supply for each field you just ploughed.

cards.name: Corral
cards.text: You may keep up to 2 animals of the same type on each unsowed field orthogonally adjacent to your home. Different corrals may hold different types of animals. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each of these fields that holds at least 1 animal.

cards.name: Cow Bell
cards.text: You may keep up to 2 cattle on each unused space on your farmyard, to a maximum of 4 cattle.

cards.name: Dunghill
cards.text: Whenever you have 2/3 different types of animals at the beginning of the field phase, you may add 1 more resource on 1/2 of your planted fields (or planted cards).

cards.name: Errant Oven
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately take a bread baking action. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Extra Effort
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Farmers Market
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 vegetable. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Fish Farm
cards.text: Whenever another player takes the "Fishing" action, you can take 1 grain or vegetable from each of your planted fields and place it in your personal supply.

cards.name: Gardening Tools
cards.text: Whenever another player sows, you may pay 1 food to the supply to immediately take a sowing action.

cards.name: Gimlet
cards.text: Pay 1 less wood/clay/stone for each wood/clay/stone room. Each round you build stables, pay 1 less wood for up to 2 stables.

cards.name: Grain Market
cards.text: Whenever you harvest at least 1 grain, you may immediately afterward exchange 1 grain from your personal supply for 1 vegetable.

cards.name: Hammer
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately take a fencing action. Pay 1 wood to every other player who has at least 1 fence.

cards.name: Harvest Feast
cards.text: When you play this card, each player may immediately move any amount of their planted resources to their personal supply.

cards.name: Hayloft
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point if you have 3 stables, or 2 bonus points if you have 4 stables.

cards.name: Hired Helpers
cards.text: Each round, you may place 1 guest token as you would a family member. If you do this, you must place 1 fewer person next round. You can not use this ability in consecutive rounds nor in round 14.

cards.name: Holiday Present
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately either discard 1 begging card or take 1 animal (of your choice) from the supply. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Horse Barn
cards.text: Whenever you sow, each field you sow that is orthogonally adjacent to exactly 1 stable gets an additional 1 grain or 1 vegetable. Each field that is orthogonally adjacent to 2 or more stables, gets an additional 2 grain or 2 vegetables.

cards.name: Irrigation Canal
cards.text: Whenever you plow a field that is orthogonally adjacent to a planted field, you may take 1 grain or vegetable from that field and sow it immediately on the newly plowed field. Place 1 fewer grain or vegetable from the supply on the newly planted field.

cards.name: Itinerant Laborers
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately take a sowing action. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Magic Beans
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 2 vegetables. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Meat Pie
cards.text: Whenever you bake 1 or more grain into bread, you may pay 1 additional

cards.name: Migrant Workers
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action space, you may immediately afterward pay 1 food to plow 1 field.

cards.name: Pelt Roof
cards.text: For each wild boar, cattle, or 2 sheep you convert into food, you may place 1 reed from the general supply on this card. You may use this reed to extend or renovate your home.

cards.name: Pine Forest
cards.text: At the start of each round, you may place 1 wood on this card if you have zero wood in your supply. When this card has 5 wood, move the wood from this card to your personal supply.

cards.name: Plentiful Fields
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 food for each planted plowed field in your farmyard. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Potter's Wheel
cards.text: Whenever you convert 1 clay into food using the Pottery or Potter, you receive 1 additional food. The Pottery is now a minor improvement for you.

cards.name: Private Market
cards.text: Once per round, you may exchange 2 food for a building resource of your choice.

cards.name: Private School
cards.text: This card is an additional action space for all players. Any player who uses the Private School must pay you 1 food to play an occupation.  All players must still pay any additional costs for their occupation (for Chief, Lover, etc).

cards.name: Pulley
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action space you may immediately afterward build one room.

cards.name: Pumpkin Pie
cards.text: Whenever you bake 1 or more grain into bread, you may pay 1 additional grain and 1 vegetable for 3 bonus points. When you play this card, you can also take a bread baking action.

cards.name: Reed Beds
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Plough 1 Field" action space, you receive 1 reed.

cards.name: Reed Sale
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 3 food. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Remodeling
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately return a stable from your farmyard to your supply and extend your wooden hut by 1 room. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Sausage Grinder
cards.text: Whenever you convert animals into food, you receive 1 additional food for each animal.

cards.name: Scythe
cards.text: You may sow fields even if they already contain resources.  Place the new resources on top of the existing ones. You cannot sow different resources on a single field.

cards.name: Seasonal Plants
cards.text: Whenever you sow during an even-numbered round, add 1 additional resource of the appropriate type to 1 field you just sowed.

cards.name: Seed Spreader
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Plough 1 Field" action space, you may immediately afterward sow 1 grain or 1 vegetable.

cards.name: Sheep Market
cards.text: At the beginning of each harvest, you may exchange 1 grain or vegetable for 1 sheep. Alternatively, you may exchange 1 sheep for 1 grain or vegetable.

cards.name: Sheepdog
cards.text: You may keep up to 2 sheep on each unused space in your farmyard. You may not keep any animal other than sheep in your home. The Sheepdog must be fed 1 food each harvest.

cards.name: Sheepskin Rug
cards.text: At the end of the game, if you own a Fireplace, you receive 2 bonus points.

cards.name: Shovel
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action space, you may immediately afterward take a sowing action.

cards.name: Sickle
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 3 bonus points if you have at least 5 plowed fields, 8 grain and 4 vegetables.

cards.name: Stone Crane
cards.text: Whenever another player builds a room or renovates, you may immediately perform this action yourself (without placing a family member). Pay the costs using 1 less building resource of your choice.

cards.name: Stone Kitchen
cards.text: At any time, you may convert goods to food as follows: vegetables → 4 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 3 food; cattle → 4 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 3 food.

cards.name: Stonecutter's Hall
cards.text: In each harvest, you can use the Stonecutter's Hall to convert exactly 1 stone to 3 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1/2/3 bonus points for 2/4/5 stone.

cards.name: Tree House
cards.text: Once you no longer live in a Wooden Hut, one of your rooms can hold an additional Family member.

cards.name: Vegetable Scoop
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Take 1 Vegetable" action space, you receive 1 additional vegetable.

cards.name: Winter Garden
cards.text: You may sow 1 of your rooms as if it were 1 field. Whenever you have an animal in your home (including House Goat), move all resources planted in this room to the general supply. Harvest resources from your room as normal and additionally at the end of rounds 6, 8, 10 and 12.

cards.name: Wooden Bridge
cards.text: Whenever you use the "1 Reed" action space, you receive 1 additional food.  Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action space, you receive 1 additional Reed.

cards.name: Alms
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 food for each completed round of the game. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Animal Feed
cards.text: Immediately before scoring, you receive 1 additional animal of each type that you already have.

cards.name: Baker's Kitchen
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can use the Baker's Kitchen to convert up to 2 grain into 5 food each. When you play this card, you can also bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Chicken Coop
cards.text: Place 1 food each on the next 8 remaining round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Clay Deposit
cards.text: This card is an additional action space. A player who uses this action space must pay you 1 food and receives 5 clay. If you use the Clay Deposit yourself, you may choose to take 2 bonus points instead of the clay.

cards.name: Clay Path
cards.text: The player with the most valuable street receives 2 bonus points when scoring.

cards.name: Cooking Corner
cards.text: At any time, you may convert goods to food as follows: vegetables → 4 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 3 food; cattle → 4 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 3 food.

cards.name: Corn Storehouse
cards.text: Whenever you have empty fields after the field phase of the harvest, you can sow grain in them immediately. Place 1 fewer grain from the supply on these fields.

cards.name: Fish Trap
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space or receive reed on an action space, you receive 1 additional food.

cards.name: Flagon
cards.text: Whenever the Well is built or upgraded to a Village Well, you receive 4 food, and the other players receive 1 food each. If the Well has already been built, everyone receives the food when the Flagon is played.

cards.name: Goose Pond
cards.text: Place 1 food each on the next 4 remaining round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Grain Cart
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Take 1 Grain" action space, you receive 2 additional grain.

cards.name: Guest
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive a guest token, which you may place once in the next round as you would a person. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Hand Mill
cards.text: During the feeding phase of the harvest, you can use the Hand Mill to turn either 1 grain into 2 food or 2 grain into 4 food.

cards.name: Harrow
cards.text: Once during the game, when you use either the "Plough 1 Field" or the "Plough Field and Sow" action space, you can plough 2 fields instead of 1. Each other player can also do this once during the game, but must pay you 2 food to do it.

cards.name: Holiday House
cards.text: In round 14, you cannot place any people. Play this card at the latest during round 13.

cards.name: Ladder
cards.text: You need 1 less reed to extend or renovate your home or to build the Water Mill, Half-timbered House, Chicken Coop, Holiday House, Mansion, or Corn Storehouse.

cards.name: Lasso
cards.text: You can place exactly two people immediately after one another, if at least one of them uses the "1 Wild Boar", "1 Cattle" or "1 Sheep" action space.

cards.name: Manure
cards.text: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can take 1 grain or vegetable from each of your fields and place it in your personal supply.

cards.name: Milking Shed
cards.text: In each harvest, at the beginning of the field phase, count the total number of sheep and cattle in all the players' farms. You receive 1 food for each fifth sheep and for each third cattle.

cards.name: Paved Road
cards.text: The player with the most valuable street receives 2 Bonus points when scoring.

cards.name: Planter Box
cards.text: Whenever you sow, each of the fields you sow that is orthogonally adjacent to a room in your home gets additional goods from the general supply: 2 extra grain on grain fields, and 1 extra vegetable on vegetable fields.

cards.name: Punner
cards.text: Whenever another player uses the Harrow or a plough, you can immediately plough 1 field as well.

cards.name: Rake
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 2 bonus points if you have at least 5 fields. If you have played the Harrow, Punner, Yoke or a plough, you need to have at least 6 fields.

cards.name: Reed Exchange
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 2 reeds. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Schnaps Distillery
cards.text: During the feeding phase of the harvest, you can use the Schnaps Distillery to convert at most 1 vegetable into 4 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point each for your 5th and 6th vegetables.

cards.name: Shepherd's Crook
cards.text: Whenever you fence a new pasture that covers at least 4 farmyard spaces, you receive 2 sheep and place them in the new pasture.

cards.name: Slaughterhouse
cards.text: Whenever another player converts 1 or more animals to food, you receive 1 food from the supply. During the feeding phase of the harvest, you are the last player to take a turn.

cards.name: Spinney
cards.text: Whenever another player uses the "3 Wood" action space, they must give you one of the wood.

cards.name: Straw-thatched Roof
cards.text: You no longer need reed when you extend or renovate your home.

cards.name: Strawberry Patch
cards.text: Place 1 food on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Tavern
cards.text: The Tavern is an additional action space. Whenever another player uses it, they receive 3 food. Whenever you use it, you can choose either to take 3 food or to score 2 bonus points.

cards.name: Threshing Board
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Plough 1 Field" or "Plough Field and Sow" action spaces, you can additionally bake bread.

cards.name: Village Well
cards.text: Place 1 food each on the next 3 remaining round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Water Mill
cards.text: After the field phase of a harvest, each player can use the Water Mill to convert up to 1 grain to 3 food. Each player that uses the Water Mill must give you 1 of the food.

cards.name: Weekly Market
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 2 vegetables. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Wildlife Reserve
cards.text: This card can hold up to 1 sheep, 1 wild boar and 1 cattle.

cards.name: Wood Cart
cards.text: Whenever you use a person to take wood that is on an action space, you receive 2 additional wood.

cards.name: Wooden Crane
cards.text: Whenever you use one of the "1 Stone" action spaces that are placed in rounds 5--7 and 10--11, you receive 1 additional stone. If you pay 1 food, you can take 2 additional stone instead of 1.

cards.name: Wooden Hut Extension
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately extend your wooden hut by 1 room. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Wooden Path
cards.text: The player with the most valuable street receives 2 bonus points when scoring.

cards.name: Acreage
cards.text: When you sow, you can plant grain on this card. There can be up to 2 stacks of grain on this card, as shown.

cards.name: Bakehouse
cards.text: Whenever you use a bread baking action, you can use the Bakehouse to convert up to 2 grain into 5 food each. When you play this card, you can also bake bread immediately.

cards.name: Beehive
cards.text: Place 2 food on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Boar Breeding
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 wild boar. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Bookshelf
cards.text: Whenever you play 1 occupation, you receive 3 food before you pay the costs of the occupation.

cards.name: Bread Paddle
cards.text: Whenever you play an occupation, you may also bake bread.

cards.name: Brewery
cards.text: During the feeding phase of the harvest, you can use the Brewery to convert at most 1 grain to 3 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for your ninth grain.

cards.name: Broom
cards.text: Discard all the remaining minor improvements in your hand, and draw 7 new minor improvements. You can play 1 more minor improvement immediately.

cards.name: Brushwood Roof
cards.text: Whenever you extend or renovate your home, you can replace 1 or 2 reed with the same amount of wood.

cards.name: Clapper
cards.text: Whenever you use one of the family growth action spaces (or if you already have used one of these spaces in this round when you play the Clapper), place 1 additional grain on all of your fields that already contains at least 1 grain.

cards.name: Clay Hut Extension
cards.text: When you play this card, immediately extend your clay hut by 1 room. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Clay Pit
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action space, you receive 3 additional clay.

cards.name: CookingHearth
cards.text: At any time, you can convert goods to food as follows: vegetables → 3 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 3 food; cattle → 4 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 3 food.

cards.name: Corn Sheaf
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 grain. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Crooked Plough
cards.text: Once during the game, when you use the "Plough 1 Field" action space, you can plough 3 fields instead of 1.

cards.name: Duck Pond
cards.text: Place 1 food on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Flail
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Plough 1 Field" or "Plough Field and Sow" action spaces, you can additionally bake bread.

cards.name: Forest Pasture
cards.text: This card can hold an unlimited number of wild boar.

cards.name: Granary
cards.text: Place 1 grain on each remaining space for rounds 8, 10 and 12. At the start of these rounds, you receive the grain.

cards.name: Greenhouse
cards.text: Add 4 and 7 to the number of the current round and place 1 vegetable on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can pay 1 food to take the vegetable.

cards.name: Herb Garden
cards.text: Place 1 food on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of each round, you receive the food.

cards.name: Horse
cards.text: You receive 2 bonus points for any one type of animal missing from your farm at the end of the game.

cards.name: House Goat
cards.text: In each feeding phase, you receive 1 food. Apart from the goat, you cannot hold any other animal in your home.

cards.name: Landing Net
cards.text: Whenever you receive reed on an action space, you receive an additional 2 food. This is reduced to 1 food if you receive other building resources as well as reed.

cards.name: Liquid Manure
cards.text: Whenever you sow, place 1 additional grain or vegetable from the general supply on each new stack you sow.

cards.name: Loom
cards.text: Whenever you have sheep during the field phase of a harvest, you receive food: 1 food if you have 1 to 3 sheep; 2 food for 4 to 6 sheep; or 3 food for 7 or more sheep. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for every 3 sheep.

cards.name: Lumber
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 3 wood. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Mansion
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 2 bonus points for each room in your stone house. In total, you receive 4 points per room instead of the usual 2 points.

cards.name: Milking Stool
cards.text: Whenever you have cattle during the field phase of a harvest, you receive food: 1 food if you have 1 or 2 cattle; 2 food if you have 3 or 4 cattle; 3 food if you have 5 or more cattle. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for every 2 cattle.

cards.name: Ox Team
cards.text: When you play this card, count how many complete rounds are left to be played. You can plough this many fields, up to a maximum of 3.

cards.name: Pelts
cards.text: For each animal that you convert to food and return to the general supply, you may place 1 food from your personal supply in 1 of your rooms. You may have a maximum of 1 food in each room. You cannot use these food any more, but each is worth 1 bonus point at the end of the game.

cards.name: Reed Hut
cards.text: Place one family member token that you have not yet brought into the game onto this card, where it will live for the rest of the game. It can take actions and must be fed, but it is not worth any points while living in the Reed Hut.

cards.name: Sawhorse
cards.text: The next stable you place in your farmyard, as well as your 3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th and 15th fence, costs you nothing.

cards.name: Sawmill
cards.text: Each harvest, you may convert up to 1 wood to 3 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1/2/3 bonus points for 2/4/5 wood.

cards.name: Sleeping Corner
cards.text: You can use any “Family Growth” action space, even if another player has already placed a person there.

cards.name: Spit Roast
cards.text: Whenever you convert at least 1 animal to food during the feeding phase of the harvest, you receive 1 additional food.

cards.name: Stone Cart
cards.text: Place 1 stone on each remaining even-numbered round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the stone.

cards.name: Stone Exchange
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 2 stone. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Swan Lake
cards.text: Place 1 food each on the next 5 remaining round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Swing Plough
cards.text: Twice during the game, when you use the "Plough 1 Field" action space, you can plough 3 fields instead of 1.

cards.name: Turnip Field
cards.text: When you sow, you can plant vegetables on this card as you would on a field. When you play this card, you can also carry out a sowing action.

cards.name: Wooden Strongbox
cards.text: At the end of the game, you get 2 bonus points if your home contains 5 rooms, or 4 bonus points if you have 6 or more rooms.

cards.name: Yoke
cards.text: When you play this card, you can immediately plough 1 field for each plough or Harrow that has been played by any player.

cards.name: Administration
cards.cost: Cost 1W 2C. Req max 4 cards in hand.
cards.text: You immediately receive 2 food. In the last harvest, for each major improvement that you have, you can exchange 1 food for 1 bonus point.

cards.name: Advance Payment
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 fuel, 1 food, 1 wood, 1 clay, 1 reed, 1 stone, 1 sheep, and 1 grain.

cards.name: Agricultural Implement
cards.text: Whenever you use a person to take the “Plough fields” action, you can take a special action card immediately afterwards, as long as it has not already been used twice.

cards.name: Alder Swamp
cards.text: Whenever you use a "Fell Trees" special action, you also receive your choice of 1 reed or 1 wood.

cards.name: Arid Field
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, place 1 fuel and 1 food from the general supply on the emptied farmyard space. You receive the token once the space is no longer empty.

cards.name: Barge
cards.text: Place, alternately, 1 fuel or 1 food on each remaining round space, beginning with 1 fuel. At the start of each round, you receive the token.

cards.name: Basic Supplies
cards.text: Immediately take goods and tokens from the general supply until you have at least 1 fuel, 1 food, 1 wood, 1 clay, 1 reed, 1 stone, and 1 grain in your personal supply. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Basket Stall
cards.text: At any time, you can exchange reed for other building resources. Return the reed to the supply and take the same number of other building resources of your choice.

cards.name: Birthing House
cards.text: Whenever you use any “family growth” action, you receive 1 bonus point as well as 1 fuel and 1 food.

cards.name: Bog Body
cards.text: The owner of the Museum of the Moors and the owner of the Living History Museum each receive 1 bonus point at the end of the game.

cards.name: Bog Forest
cards.text: Immediately place 1 forest tile on as many of your own moor tiles as you wish. You can only use the covered moor tiles once you have removed the forest tiles with the "Fell Trees" special action. You cannot use "Slash and Burn" on forest tiles that are on top of moor tiles.

cards.name: Bog Pony
cards.text: At any time, you can lie one of your horses that is standing up on its side and take 2 fuel. This horse does not count during the breeding phase of the harvest. At the end of the game, it is worth only half a point, but it can (like other horses) be converted into food with an appropriate improvement.

cards.name: Building Plan
cards.text: Whenever you build 2 rooms at once with the “Build rooms” action, you can immediately build 2 stables from your personal supply.

cards.name: Built-in Oven
cards.text: You no longer need to pay any heating costs.

cards.name: Butcher's Block
cards.text: This card cannot be played in a round that is followed by a harvest. All other players must and you may immediately convert one animal of their (your) choice to food. Sheep provide 1 food, wild boar 2 food, cattle 3 food.

cards.name: Cattle Collar
cards.text: Whenever you use the ”Plough Field” action or the "Slash and Burn" special action, you can immediately place 1 additional field tile on an empty farmyard space. To do this, you must have at least 1 cattle in your farm.

cards.name: Cattle Stall
cards.text: Add 2, 4, 6, 8 to the current round. Place 1 animal on each corresponding round space. You choose which animal goes on which space, but all the animals must be different. At the start of these rounds, you can buy the animal for 1 food.

cards.name: Ceramics Stall
cards.text: At any time, you can exchange clay for wood. Return the clay to the supply and take the same number of wood.

cards.name: Chamber of Commerce
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 wood and 1 reed. At the end of the game, each of these major improvements: Joinery, Pottery and Basketmaker's Workshop is worth 1 additional bonus point to you.

cards.name: Chimney Hood
cards.text: You immediately receive as much food as you would receive from one of your baking improvements if you baked 1 grain into bread. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Church
cards.text: For upgrading the Village Church to the Church, you receive 2 food. At the end of each round, you can tithe up to 1 fuel to earn 1 bonus point.

cards.name: Clear Felling
cards.text: You immediately receive 2 wood. You can immediately turn over up to 2 forest tiles to show the moor side, as long as there is nothing except the forest tile on those spaces. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Co-operative Store
cards.text: Place 4 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can remove 1 of them to exchange any 1 building resource for any other building resource except stone.

cards.name: Coal Seam
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 fuel. Whenever you use the "Hiring Fair" special action or the "Day Labourer" action space, you also receive 1 fuel.

cards.name: Cookhouse
cards.text: You can exchange goods for food at any time, as follows: vegetables → 3 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 3 food; cattle → 4 food; horses → 2 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 3 food.

cards.name: Deep Plough
cards.text: Immediately place 1 moor tile on an empty space in your farmyard. Whenever you use a person to take the “Plough fields” action, you can also exchange one moor tile for 1 field tile.

cards.name: Draughthorses
cards.text: Whenever you take exactly 3 wood from an action space, you can pay 1 food to receive 1 additional wood. Whenever you take 4 or more wood from an action space, you can pay 1 food to receive 2 additional wood. To do either of these, you must have at least 1 horse.

cards.name: Drying Field
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, add 3 to the current round. Place 2 fuel on the corresponding round space. At the start of the round, you receive the fuel.

cards.name: Edge of the Forest
cards.text: For each border between a forest tile and a field in your farmyard, you receive 1 food. For each border between a forest tile and a moor tile in your farmyard, you receive 1 fuel. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Fallow Fields
cards.text: Place 2 food from the general supply on each of up to 3 empty fields. You cannot harvest the food. You receive it when you sow in the fields.

cards.name: Fallow Land
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fell Trees" or "Cut Peat" special actions to clear a space in your farmyard, place 1 Food on the space. You receive the food when the space is no longer empty.

cards.name: Family Burial Plot
cards.text: Immediately place the tombstone on an unused space in your farmyard. That space cannot be used to hold anything now, but is counted as used, and is worth 1 additional bonus point at the end of the game.

cards.name: Farm Cart
cards.text: Whenever you take at least 5 wood, 4 clay, 3 reeds, or 2 stone from an action space, you also receive 1 grain.

cards.name: Farm Extension
cards.text: This card gives you 2 additional spaces which you can use as normal farmyard spaces. Place it beside your farmyard. Each of the new spaces must border an existing farmyard space. This expands your famyard by 2 spaces.

cards.name: Farmhands' Quarters
cards.text: Whenever you acquire a major improvement, you can save 1 building resource of your choice by paying 1 fuel instead. Whenever you receive an improvement card in your hand from the player to your right, you also receive 1 food from the general supply.

cards.name: Fire Brigade
cards.text: You immediately receive 2 food. If you still have forest tiles on at least 2 farm yard spaces, you get bonus points: 1 fewer point than you have forests, with a maximum of 4 points.

cards.name: Firewood
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 fuel. Whenever you convert at least 1 wood to fuel during a harvest to heat your home, you need a total of 1 fuel fewer.

cards.name: Fish Smokehouse
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you can pay 1 fuel to receive an additional 3 food.

cards.name: Flatboat
cards.text: Place, alternately, 1 fuel or 1 horse on each of the next 7 remaining round spaces, beginning with 1 fuel. At the start of each round, you receive the fuel or the horse.

cards.name: Forest Hut
cards.text: Immediately place 1 guest marker on one of your forest tiles. You will receive the guest marker when you use a special action to clear that forest tile. Then, in that same round, you can place the guest marker as you would a person. At the end of that round, return the guest marker to the supply.

cards.name: Forest Kindergarten
cards.text: Whenever you take any “family growth” action, you receive 1 food for each of your farmyard spaces that contains a forest tile.

cards.name: Forest Path
cards.text: You immediately receive 3 wood. Once this card has been passed, the player who has it at the end of the game receives -1 point. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Forest Swamp
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, turn over the moor tile that you remove. Add 4 to the current round and place the tile on the corresponding round space. At the start of the round, you can place the forest tile on an empty space in your farmyard.

cards.name: Forester's Lodge
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fell Trees" special action, you receive 1 additional wood. If you have at least one horse at the time, you receive another 1 wood. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each forest in your farmyard.

cards.name: Fuel Storage
cards.text: Add 1, 5, and 9 to the current round. Place 1 wood on each corresponding round space. Add 3, 7, and 11 to the current round. Place 1 fuel on each corresponding round space. At the start of each round, you receive the wood or fuel.

cards.name: Furnace
cards.text: You immediately receive 2 fuel. When heating, you heat one room fewer than you have.

cards.name: Furniture Stall
cards.text: At any time, you can exchange wood for clay. Return the wood to the supply and take the same number of clay.

cards.name: Grain Distillery
cards.text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can convert exactly 1 fuel and 1 grain to 5 food. In the final harvest, you can convert any number of pairs of 1 fuel and 1 grain from your supply to 1 bonus point per pair.

cards.name: Hardware Store
cards.text: Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return one usage counter to the supply and take 1 of each building resource that you have none of.

cards.name: Hay Wagon
cards.text: Immediately after you take 3 wood, 3 clay, 2 reed, or 2 stone from an action space, you can take a “Build room(s)” or “Renovate” action without placing a person.

cards.name: Healing Clay
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 food. Whenever you take the "Infirmary" action with a person who is marked with a bed token, you receive 1 additional food.

cards.name: Hearth Brush
cards.text: If the Stone Oven has not yet been built, you can immediately place it underneath the Heating Stove. From next round, whenever you use a person to take an action, you can build the Heating Stove immediately afterwards by paying the required resources. The Heating Stove is worth 1 additional bonus point for you.

cards.name: Heating Stove
cards.text: Regardless of its size, you need at most 1 fuel to heat your entire home.

cards.name: Home Wood
cards.text: With this improvement, you can keep 1 animal (except a sheep) on each of your forest tiles.

cards.name: Horse Butcher
cards.text: At any time, you may convert animals to food as follows: sheep → 1 food; wild boar → 2 food; cattle → 3 food; horse → 2 food; 2 horses → 5 food.

cards.name: Horse Slaughterhouse
cards.text: With the Horse Slaughterhouse, you can convert your animals to food at any time, as follows: sheep → 1 food; wild boar → 1 food; cattle → 2 food; horses → 2 food.

cards.name: Horse Trough
cards.text: You can keep up to 2 horses in an unused farmyard space adjacent to your home.

cards.name: Household Inventory
cards.cost: Cost 1F. Req 1 field, pasture, or stable.
cards.text: If you have 5/6/7/8/9/10 empty farmyard spaces, you receive the first 1/2/3/4/5/6 goods from the following list (in order): 1 reed, 1 grain, 1 cattle, 1 stone, 1 vegetable, 1 horse. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Land Parcel
cards.text: When you play this card, you receive 1 forest tile that you must immediately place on an empty space in your farmyard. At the end of the game, you receive 2 bonus point if you have 1 unused farmyard space, you receive -1 bonus point if you have 2 unused spaces, and you receive -3 bonus point if you have 3 or more unused spaces.

cards.name: Large Livestock Market
cards.text: You can immediately exchange 2 sheep for 1 cattle and 1 horse. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Leather Saddle
cards.text: Whenever you have at least 3 horses, you receive 1 bonus point for each cattle that you convert to food.

cards.name: Livestock Market
cards.text: You can immediately exchange up to 3 animals for the next most valuable animal. You must swap them al at the same time, and you can only take the new animals if you have room for all of them on your farm. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Living History Museum
cards.cost: 4VP. Return Museum o/t Moors. Req clay hut.
cards.text: The following major improvements are cheaper for you: Village Church, by 1 stone; Furniture Stall, by 1 wood; Ceramics Stall, by 1 clay; Basket Stall, by 1 reed; Furnace, by 1 clay; Heating Stove, by 1 stone; Riding Stables, by 1 wood.

cards.name: Loam
cards.text: Whenever you have placed all except one of your people during the work phase and you use the "Hiring Fair" special action, you receive 1 additional clay.

cards.name: Loan
cards.text: At the start of each harvest, shuffle all the start cards and draw 1. The start cards are numbered from 1 to 9. If the number on the card is equal to or less than the amount of clay you have in your supply, the 2 food that you paid are returned to you with interest: you receive 6 food but must pass this improvement to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Malthouse
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, you can also convert 1 grain to 4 food.

cards.name: Moor Archaeology
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, you can place 1 fence from your supply on the emptied farmyard space. You cannot use this farmyard space to hold anything, but it is counted as used, and is worth 1 additional bonus point at the end of the game.

cards.name: Moor Birch Tree
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, you also receive 2 wood.

cards.name: Moor Enclosures
cards.text: Place 2 Moor tiles on this card. The card represents 2 additional, normal farmyard spaces. Place it beside your farmyard. Each of the new spaces must border an existing farmyard space. This expands your farm by 2 spaces.

cards.name: Moor Fire
cards.text: Once you only have 1 remaining moor tile, you can exchange it for a field tile at any time.

cards.name: Museum of the Moors
cards.text: The following major improvements are cheaper for you: Well, by 1 stone; Joinery, by 1 wood; Pottery, by 1 clay; Basketmaker's Workshop, by 1 reed; Clay Oven, by 1 clay; Stone Oven, by 1 stone; Forester's Lodge, by 1 clay.

cards.name: Nature Reserve
cards.text: Immediately fence 1 farmyard space which contains a forest or moor tile. You do not pay any wood for these fences. Once there are no tiles left on the space, it becomes a pasture.

cards.name: Nature's Fertilizer
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Slash and Burn" special action, you immediately receive a “Sow” action for that field only. This also applies if you turn 1 moor tile into a field using the Moor Fire or Peat Burn-off minor improvement.

cards.name: Night Pasture
cards.text: You can keep 3 animals of your choice on this card, and other players can keep 1. All the animals on this card count as yours when animals breed. You are always the last to play during the breeding phase.

cards.name: No-Till Farming
cards.text: You can plant grain or vegetables on up to 2 empty farmyard spaces. These spaces do not count as fields when scoring, but as empty spaces.

cards.name: Nosebag
cards.text: Whenever you use the “Take 1 Grain” action, you also receive 1 horse.

cards.name: Oak Bark
cards.text: You immediately receive 2 wood. Whenever you convert cattle, wild boar, or horses to food, you receive 1 additional wood for each of these animals that you convert.

cards.name: Open Grill
cards.text: At any time, you may convert goods to food as follows: vegetable → 2 food; sheep → 2 food; wild boar → 3 food; cattle → 3 food; horse → 2 food. Whenever you use a bread baking action, you may convert: grain → 2 food.

cards.name: Out on the Wallaby
cards.text: You receive goods if you own craftman's buildings. Joinery: 3 wood; Pottery: 3 clay; Basketmaker's Workshop: 2 reeds. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Oven Damper
cards.text: You immediately receive 3 fuel. The Clay Oven, Stone Oven, Furnace and Heating Stove major improvements and the Built-in Oven minor improvement are each worth 1 additional bonus point to you.

cards.name: Pastoral Letter
cards.text: If the Well has not yet been built, you can immediately place it under the Village Church. From next round, whenever you use a person to take an action, you can build the Village Church immediately afterwards by paying the required resources. The Village Church and the Church are each worth 1 additional bonus point for you.

cards.name: Peat Ash Fertilizer
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, you can place 1 additional grain on all fields and farmyard spaces where grain is growing. In addition, you can place 1 additional vegetable on all fields and farmyard spaces where vegetables are planted.

cards.name: Peat Barge
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action, you also receive 2 fuel.

cards.name: Peat Bath
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Infirmary" action space with a person, count how many moor tiles are in your farmyard. Place 1 food on the next remaining round space(s) up to that number. At the beginning of those rounds, you receive the food.

cards.name: Peat Boat
cards.text: At any time, you can exchange fuel for goods as follows: 3 fuel → 2 wood or 2 clay; 4 fuel → 2 reed or 2 stone; 2 fuel → 1 grain; 3 fuel → 1 vegetable.

cards.name: Peat Burn-off
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 fuel. In addition you can (optionally) immediately exchange 1 moor tile for a field tile. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Peat Fertilizer
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, you can immediately take a “Sow” action.

cards.name: Peat Hut
cards.text: This card serves as a room for one of your people. It must be heated with 1 fuel during the feeding phase of each harvest. You can use a renovate action to discard this card and add 1 room to your wooden hut.

cards.name: Peat Iron
cards.text: Whenever you have at least 2 moor tiles in your farmyard at the start of a harvest, you receive 1 fuel.

cards.name: Peat Moss
cards.text: You require 2 less wood and 1 less reed to build wooden hut rooms.

cards.name: Peat Pellets
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 fuel for each remaining moor tile in your farmyard. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Peat Sled
cards.text: Add your choice of 2, 4, 7, or 10 to the current round number. On the corresponding round space, place 3, 4, 5, or 6 fuel (depending on which number you added). At the start of that round, you receive the fuel.

cards.name: Peat-Cutting Rights
cards.text: Add 4 and 7 to the current round. Place 1 moor tile on each of the corresponding rounds. These tiles show that you can use the special action "Cut Peat" at the start of the round.

cards.name: Peat-charcoal Kiln
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Cut Peat" special action, you receive 1 additional fuel. If you have at least one horse at the time, you receive another 1 fuel. In the final harvest, you can exchange 3 fuel for 1 bonus point, or 5 fuel for 2 bonus points.

cards.name: Peat-cutting Expedition
cards.text: Immediately take as many moor tiles from your farmyard as you wish. For each moor tile that you remove, you receive 1 bonus point and 2 fuel. If you have at least 2 horses, you receive 1 additional fuel for each horse except the first one, up to a maximum of 4 additional fuel. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Pheromones
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 food. In addition, each player who has at least one stable or pasture receives 2 food.

cards.name: Ploughhorse Market
cards.text: Whenever you use a person to take a “Plough fields” action, you can buy 1 horse for 1 food immediately afterwards.

cards.name: Pot Roast Recipe
cards.text: You can use the Fireplace or Cooking Hearth major improvements to convert horses to food. You receive 2 food for each horse.

cards.name: Reforestation
cards.text: Immediately place 1 forest tile on an empty space in your farmyard. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Register of Craftsmen
cards.text: Immediately acquire the Joinery, Pottery, or Basketmaker's Workshop, without placing a person. You pay 1 stone less for it. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Riding Stables
cards.text: Place 1 food on the round space for each remaining round. At the start of these rounds, you receive the food, as long as you have at least 2 horses.

cards.name: River Clay
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you also receive 2 clay.

cards.name: Riverside Woods
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you receive 1 additional wood for each of your farmyard spaces with a forest tile, up to a maximum of 3 wood.

cards.name: Routine Work
cards.text: Whenever you choose not to use a craftman's building to convert building resources to food during the harvest, you receive your choice of 1 food or 1 fuel instead.

cards.name: Sowing Machine
cards.text: Whenever you use a special action, you may immediately take a “Sow” action as long as you have at least 2 horses.

cards.name: Special Pasture
cards.text: Immediately fence 1 empty farmyard space (or a farmyard space with a stable) with 4 fences. You need not pay wood for these. The fenced space may not border your existing pastures.

cards.name: Spinning Mill
cards.text: For every 2 sheep that you have in the field phase of each harvest, you pay 1 fuel less to heat your home in the feeding phase of that round.

cards.name: Stock-breeding Prize
cards.cost: Cost 1 grain. Req no unused spaces.
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each other player in the game, as long as you have at least 1 animal of each of the 4 types. These points are doubled or tripled if you have 2 or 3 of each type of animal.

cards.name: Stone Quarry
cards.text: Place 5 stone on this card. Whenever you use the "Hiring Fair" special action, you also receive 1 stone from this card.

cards.name: Stone Wagon
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Day Labourer" action, you also receive 1 stone.

cards.name: Surveyor's Map
cards.text: Place a field tile on the space for round 11, a moor tile on round 12, and a forest tile on round 13. At the start of the rounds, you must either place the tile on an empty space in your farm or return it to the supply.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.text: Place 1 moor tile on the space for round 12. At the start of this round, you can take the tile and place it on an empty space in your farmyard.

cards.name: Taps
cards.text: You can take an available special action card even after you have already placed all your person markers, when it would be your turn again. Then the work phase is over for you.

cards.name: Thicket
cards.text: Choose up to 2 forest tiles, and place 1 additional forest tile on top of each of them. You can remove 1 tile with the "Fell Trees" special action---you cannot use the "Slash and Burn" action on spaces with 2 forest tiles.

cards.name: Timber Mill
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fell Trees" special action or take at least 4 wood from an action space, you receive 1 additional wood. If you pay 1 fuel, you receive 1 more additional wood.

cards.name: Tinker
cards.text: If you have at least one of the Joinery, Pottery, or Basketmaker's Workshop major improvements, you immediately receive 1 wood, 1 clay, 1 reed, and 1 stone. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Tool Shed
cards.text: Whenever you take the special action card with "Slash and Burn" and "Cut Peat", and take one of these special actions, you can take both of these special actions (in whichever order you choose).

cards.name: Tree Nursery
cards.text: Place 1 forest tile on the spaces for rounds 12 and 13. At the start of these rounds, you can take the tile and place it on an empty space in your farmyard.

cards.name: Village Church
cards.text: You immediately receive 2 food. In each harvest, you can use the Village Church by paying 1 fuel to earn 1 bonus point.

cards.name: Village Hall
cards.text: In each round where you finish the work phase without a special action card in front of you, you receive 1 food during the returning home phase,

cards.name: Village Shop
cards.text: Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can remove them to receive 1 other good or marker. The offer changes each round: 2: food, 3: grain, 4: fuel, 5: wood, 6: clay, 7: sheep, 8: reed, 9: wild boar, 10: stone, 11: cattle, 12: horse, 13: vegetable, 14: guest marker.

cards.name: Wedding Coach
cards.text: You can immediately carry out a “family growth even without space in your home” action, but you do not place a person to take this action. Place the offspring on this card until the returning home phase.

cards.name: Wheelbarrow
cards.text: Whenever you take at least 4 of the same building resources from an action space, you also receive 1 fuel. Whenever you "Cut Peat", you also receive 1 building resource of your choice.

cards.name: Wild Fields
cards.text: You can immediately place up to 2 field tiles on empty spaces in your farmyard---on the condition that neither tile borders any other field at the time when it is placed.

cards.name: Wild Harvest
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 food. At the start of each harvest, shuffle all the start cards and draw 1. The start cards are numbered from 1 to 9. If the number on the card is equal to or less than the number of forest tiles in your farmyard, you receive 1 food.

cards.name: Willow Bank
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fell Trees" special action, you also receive 1 reed.

cards.name: Winter Storehouse
cards.text: Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time (even while you are taking an action) you can return 1 usage counter and take fuel and food from the supply until you have at least 2 fuel and 2 food.

cards.name: Workbench
cards.text: You receive 3 wood, 2 clay, and 1 reed in the field phase of each of the last 2 harvests.

sets.name: Minor Improvement — Z-deck (Farmers of the Moor)

cards.name: Barbecue
cards.text: When you play this card, you can convert as many animals to food as you have family members. For each sheep, you receive 3 food; for each wild boar, 4; and for each cattle, 5. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Brewer's Copper
cards.text: During the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use the Brewer's Copper to convert at most 1 grain to 2 food. At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point if you have at least 7 grain.

cards.name: Bust
cards.text: This card cannot be played once all other players have 2 or more occupations (3 occupations in a 3-player game, 4 occupations in a 2-player game).

cards.name: Dozing Bull
cards.text: As long as you have at least 1 cattle in your farm, you can knock down your fences and rebuild them at any time, for no cost.

cards.name: Family Portrait
cards.text: Pay 2 food for each of your family members, and receive a total of 4 bonus points. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Giant Pumpkin
cards.text: Place 1 vegetable from your own supply on this card. At any time, you can harvest this vegetable and convert it to food. If it is still on the card at the end of the game, you receive 2 bonus points.

cards.name: Keg
cards.text: Once all the people have been placed in this round, you may place a guest marker to carry out an additional action. After you play this card, pass it to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.

cards.name: Maypole
cards.text: Play this card before the end of round 4. When you play this card, place one of your unbuilt fences upright on an unused farmyard space. If you have not knocked it over by the end of the game, it is worth 2 bonus points.

cards.name: Pumpkin Seed Oil
cards.text: Three times during the game (but at most once per round), you can place 1 vegetable from your personal supply on this card and receive 3 food in exchange. The vegetables on this card are counted in the scoring at the end of the game.

cards.name: Ranch
cards.text: For each round that has not yet begun when you play this card, you receive 1 bonus point and 2 food.

cards.name: Scarecrow
cards.text: Whenever you sow, you can pay 1 wood and sow 2 grain instead of 1 on an empty field.

cards.name: Stump-Jump Plough
cards.text: Once you live in a clay hut or stone house, whenever you use a person's action to take wood you can pay 1 food to also plow 1 field.

cards.name: Coffee House
cards.text: The Coffee House is an action space for all players. Whenever a player uses the Coffee House, that player and the card's owner each receive 1 food from the general supply. In the next round, the person from this space can be placed before the starting player places his first person.

cards.name: Compulsory Education
cards.text: Whenever you have family growth, you can pay 1 food to immediately play an occupation.

cards.name: Emergency Housing
cards.text: Select 1 of your built stables. It is now a room for one of your family members. The stable loses its original function, but it is still worth 1 additional point if fenced.

cards.name: Farmers' Ball
cards.text: When this card is played, each player who immediately pays 5 food into the general supply receives 3 bonus points.

cards.name: Guest Worker
cards.text: Take a Guest marker. From the next round, you can place this as you would a family member. The guest worker can use the most recent round card even if it has already been taken. He occupies a room in your home and must be fed with 2 food during the feeding phase of each harvest.

cards.name: Lederhosen
cards.text: For each sheep that you convert to food, place 1 food from the general supply on this card. If, at the end of the game, you have at least as many food on the Lederhosen as you have family members, you receive 2 bonus points; if you have twice as many, you receive 3 bonus points.

cards.name: Neutrality
cards.text: In the next round, you can only place your people after the other players have placed all of theirs. For each person that you place late, you receive 1 bonus point.

cards.name: Schnitzel Mallet
cards.text: For each cattle that you turn to food using a cooking improvement, you receive 1 additional food and 1 bonus point.

cards.name: Spielefest
cards.text: The Spielefest is an action space for all players. Whenever a player visits the Spielefest, he pays the owner of this card 1 food and receives 2 bonus points.

cards.name: Styrian Oak
cards.text: Place 5 food from the general supply on the Styrian Oak. At the start of each round, you can return 1 food to the general supply. Once during the game, at any time, you can pay the number of food (0 to 5) remaining on the Styrian Oak to receive 6 wood from the supply.

cards.name: Unusual Architecture
cards.text: Whenever you extend your home with 1 or more rooms, you receive 2 food for each new room.

cards.name: Vineyard
cards.text: Whenever you use the “Sow” action, you can plant up to 3 food on this card. Up to 3 stacks of food may be planted on it in total. These food are treated in the same way as sowed grain and are harvested during the harvest.

cards.name: Bagpiper
cards.text: You receive 2 food immediately. The person who took the occupation action immediately returns home, as if he has not been used this round. The action space “Occupation” is now unoccupied, and can be used again.

cards.name: Bureaucrat
cards.text: Place up to 3 food from your personal supply on this card. Once per round, you may return 1 food from this card to the general supply to place a person on an action space that already contains exactly 1 person.

cards.name: Fortune Teller
cards.text: You immediately receive 1 stone from the general supply. Immediately look at the top 3 cards of the round card deck, and return them face down to the top of the deck, in any order you choose. You may look at the action card of the next round at any time in the game.

cards.name: Governor
cards.text: Immediately take the top 4 occupations from the face-down deck, and choose 2 of them. You may play one of them immediately (taking into account the requirements on the card) without cost, and add the other one to your hand. If you don't want to play any, add both occupations to your hand.

cards.name: Hero
cards.text: You receive 3 food immediately. Once during the game, you can pay 1 wild boar to carry out a family growth action without placing one of your people. You must have room in your home. The newborn can start taking actions in the next round.

cards.name: Informer
cards.text: Immediately turn 1 of your occupations before you face down. You receive your choice of 5 food or 1 cattle from the general supply. You lose all effects of the face down occupation.

cards.name: Jack-of-all-trades
cards.text: Immediately discard all the occupations that you have played. In every round, you can pay 1 food to use an occupation played by another player. You receive all benefits, except for those for playing the card and those at the end of the game. Discard the Jack-of-all-trades when you play another occupation.

cards.name: Nicholas
cards.text: Immediately take 1 food from the general supply for each family member that has been born during the game so far, but no more than 6 food. All players with the least number of offspring (possibly including you) get 1 vegetable each.

cards.name: Only Child
cards.text: You receive wood immediately when you play this card: if played in round 9, 10, or 11, take 1 wood; if played in round 6, 7, or 8, take 2 wood; if played before round 6, take 3 wood. At the end of the game, you receive 3 bonus points if you have exactly 3 family members.

cards.name: Robber
cards.text: Once per round, you can skip placing a family member when it's your turn. Instead, you take your choice of 1 food or 1 wood from the general supply. You can only skip your turn if at least one other player still has at least one person left to place.

cards.name: Teacher of Nations
cards.text: All players can pay 1 food less whenever they play an occupation. Whenever one of the other players uses this discount, you receive 1 food from the general supply.

cards.name: Weekend Worker
cards.text: Whenever you renovate your home, you may at the same time build 1 room. This costs you 1 reed, 1 of the old construction material of your home before renovating (wood or clay), and 2 of the new construction material (clay or stone).

cards.name: Animal Keeper
cards.text: You can keep sheep, wild boar and cattle in the same pasture.

cards.name: Baker
cards.text: During each harvest, you may bake bread at the start of the feeding phase if you have an appropriate improvement. When you play this card, you may bake bread as an additional action.

cards.name: Basketmaker
cards.text: In each harvest, the Basketmaker can convert up to 1 reed to 3 food.

cards.name: Berry Picker
cards.text: Whenever you use a person's action to take wood, you receive an additional 1 food.

cards.name: Braggart
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive bonus points for the number of improvements in front of you: for 9 or more improvements, 9 points; for 8 improvements, 7 points; for 7 improvements, 5 points; for 6 improvements, 3 points; for 5 improvements, 1 point.

cards.name: Bread Seller
cards.text: You receive 1 food from the general supply for each grain that is baked whenever any player (including yourself) bakes bread.

cards.name: Brush Maker
cards.text: Whenever you convert wild boar to food, you place the boar on this card. At the end of the game, you receive bonus points if you have wild boar markers on this card: {4 or more markers, 3 points; 3 markers, 2 points; 2 markers, 1 point}.

cards.name: Carpenter
cards.text: To extend your home, you need only 3 of the appropriate resource and 2 reed for each new room.

cards.name: Cattle Whisperer
cards.text: Add 5 and 9 to the number of the current round. Place 1 cattle on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you receive the cattle.

cards.name: Charcoal Burner
cards.text: You receive 1 food and 1 wood whenever any player (including you) builds a baking improvement with a “baking” symbol.

cards.name: Chief
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive 1 bonus point for each room in your stone house. Playing this card costs an additional 2 food.

cards.name: Chief's Daughter
cards.text: If another player plays the Chief card, you can play this card immediately at no cost. At the end of the game, you receive 3 bonus points if you have a stone house, 1 if you have a clay hut.

cards.name: Clay Deliveryman
cards.text: Place 1 clay on each remaining space for rounds 6 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you receive the clay.

cards.name: Clay Firer
cards.text: You can use the Clay Firer at any time to convert 2 clay to 1 stone or 3 clay to 2 stone.

cards.name: Clay Mixer
cards.text: Whenever you take only clay with one of your people's actions, you receive 2 additional clay.

cards.name: Clay Seller
cards.text: You can use the Clay Seller at any time to convert 2 clay to 1 sheep or 1 reed, 3 clay to 1 wild boar or 1 stone, and/or 4 clay to 1 cattle.

cards.name: Conjurer
cards.text: Whenever you use the “Traveling Players” action on an action space, you receive 1 additional grain.

cards.name: Conservator
cards.text: You can renovate your wooden hut to a stone house without first needing to renovate it to a clay hut.

cards.name: Cook
cards.text: In the feeding phase of each harvest, only 2 of your people eat 2 food each; all others are satisfied with only 1 food each.

cards.name: Dancer
cards.text: Whenever you use the “Traveling Players” action on an action space, you receive at least 4 food, even if only 1 to 3 food are on the space.

cards.name: Dock Worker
cards.text: At any time, you can use the Dock Worker to convert 3 wood to either 1 clay, 1 reed or 1 stone, or to convert 2 clay, 2 reed or 2 stone to 1 other building resource.

cards.name: Estate Manager
cards.text: At the end of the game, you receive bonus points, if for none of the three animal species, any other player has more animals than you: in a 3 player game, 2 points; in a 4 player game, 3 points; in a 5 player game, 4 points.

cards.name: Farmer
cards.text: The next time you build fences, you receive 1 wild boar. Each time you build at least 1 fence after that, you receive 1 cattle.

cards.name: Field Warden
cards.text: You can use the "Take 1 Vegetable", "Plough 1 Field" and "Plough Field and Sow" action spaces even if another player has already placed a person on the space.

cards.name: Fisherman
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Fishing" action space, you can choose to take twice as many food as is on the space. If you do this, you must give 1 food each to the owners of the Fishing Rod, Raft, Canoe, Fish Trap, and Landing Net.

cards.name: Greengrocer
cards.text: Whenever you use the "Take 1 Grain" action space, you also receive 1 vegetable.

cards.name: Grocer
